title: Collaboration & Smart Notes
description: Introducing real-time collaboration features, smart annotations, and the foundation for the 'Git for Data' workflow.

sections.title: Smart Notes System
items: **Cell Annotations**: Add context-aware notes to any cell using the right-click menu.
**Threaded Discussions**: Click on note indicators (amber triangles) to view and reply to threads.
**Resolution Workflow**: Mark notes as resolved to keep track of tasks.
**Visual Indicators**: Indicators for cells with active notes for quick visual scanning.

sections.title: Real-Time Collaboration
items: **Live Cursors**: See where other users are working in real-time.
**Follow Me Mode**: Click on a user's cursor to automatically follow their navigation.
**Presence Counter**: Live count of active users on the dashboard (powered by SurrealDB).

sections.title: Git for Data (Beta)
items: **Private Mode**: Toggle Private Mode to edit in an isolated branch without affecting the main view.
**Diff View**: Preview changes before merging them back to the main branch.
**Branching Logic**: Implementation of core branching and merging capabilities in the Data Engine.

sections.title: Performance & Improvements
items: **Engine Optimization**: Verified stable performance with 10,000+ rows.
**Search & Replace**: Optimized search engine for large datasets.
**SurrealDB Integration**: foundational setup for future real-time features.

sections.title: Backend Architecture & Stability
items: **SurrealDB Migration**: Complete migration of core database to SurrealDB v2 for scalability.
**Robust Authentication**: Updated WorkOS integration with stable user management.
**Server Stability**: Resolved critical startup issues and improved experimental feature handling.
**Legacy Compatibility**: Added support for legacy endpoints to ensure smooth transition.
